text:
A: Hiya. Can you hear me alright?
B: Yeah. Graham.
A: Liam. Er, I'm in Doncaster. Where are you?
B: Tipton. Black Country.
A: Oh right. I saw the West Brom calendar on your picture. You a Baggies fan, then?
B: All me life.
A: I'm Rovers. Doncaster Rovers. Not quite the same, you know, but I go when I can. Few home games a season with me brother-in-law. Depends on money really, it's not cheap now even for League Two. Did you get the result Saturday?
B: Draw. Should've won it.
A: That's annoying, that. We lost. Again. Three in a row now, I think. Sorry, say if you're not bothered about football.
B: No. It's alright.
A: Do you still go, to the Hawthorns?
B: Not now. Knees. Had a season ticket once.
A: Yeah, my dad were the same, he stopped going in the end. Er... he used to take me when I were little. Belle Vue, the old ground. Freezing, it were. Anyway. What did you do, for work, like?
B: Toolmaker. Lathes, grinders. Then maintenance.
A: Proper job, that. I'm just shelf-stacking. Nights, at a supermarket. It's alright though. I did have a forklift ticket, but it's run out now.
B: Nights. I did nights for a bit. Never got used to it.
A: No, your sleep goes all over the place. I sort of sleep in bits. I'm up about one, have me tea, then it's back to work by ten. And the bloke downstairs has his music on in the afternoon, so... yeah.
B: Ar. Yow need your sleep.
A: You do. Are you retired now, then?
B: Three year.
A: Do you miss it?
B: Bit. Days are long.
A: Yeah. Yeah, I can imagine. I'd probably go fishing every day if I didn't work. That's what I do, coarse fishing. Ponds, canal, that sort of thing. Just me and a flask. Have you ever done any?
B: When I was a lad. Canal at Tipton. Never caught much.
A: Nobody does on the canal, to be fair. Half the time it's a shopping trolley. I got a decent carp at a pond last month, mind. Took about ten minutes to get it in. Sorry, I'm going on.
B: No. Carp's good.
A: Have you got owt you do, like, hobbies?
B: Shed. Mower engine. Birds, I feed the birds.
A: Oh, that's nice, that. What do you get?
B: Robins. Blue tits. Pigeons eat most of it.
A: Ha, they would. Er... so, I think we've probably got about a minute or so.
B: Ar.
A: Well, it's been nice talking to you. Hope the Baggies win next week.
B: Yow an' all. Rovers.
A: Cheers, Graham. Ta-ra.
